name: Teams, travel and a place to call home

pages.text: You can claim land in the Overworld. Build your main workshop with your team’s claim and chunk-loading allowances in mind; chunk loading depends on rank.$(br2)Waystone travel is free. Activate destinations as you explore so you can return to the places that matter. Travel convenience does not replace the requirements for entering a locked dimension.

Keep Inventory is enabled. Dying still interrupts an expedition, and a dangerous location can be difficult to return to, so bring supplies and prepare a safe route even when your inventory is protected.$(br2)Ready for the next step: you have a safe workshop, renewable food and a clear first project.
